description: This file configures Axios HTTP client for the frontend application. It manages API base URL resolution, token handling (including refresh logic), and request/response interceptors to attach tokens and handle authentication errors. It also provides functions to get API URLs and tokens, accommodating environment-specific configurations and proxy setups.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1'.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Determines if running inside Kavia preview environment based on window location hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Constructs the origin URL in Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment base URL values, handling relative paths, absolute URLs, and common proxy patterns.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL considering environment variables and environment-specific adjustments.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes the '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL.

methods.name: formatAuthorizationHeaderValue
methods.description: Formats a token string to ensure it starts with 'Bearer '.

methods.name: extractTokensFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from backend response data.
